title: 星図をたどる、真夏のオアシス
author: 小春 ことり

en.title: Tracing the Star Map: A Midsummer Oasis
en.premise: Tucked away in a corner of the city is "Oasis," a small cafe that makes you forget the sweltering urban heat. While working there, I encounter a young man who holds an old star chart close to his chest. What is it he seeks at the end of that map? And what of my own trembling heart? Amidst the summer heat, a story of two people begins to unfold—quietly, yet surely.

zh.title: 追寻星图，盛夏的绿洲
zh.premise: 在城市的角落，有一间名为“绿洲”的小咖啡馆，仿佛能让人忘却都市的燥热。在那里工作的我，某天遇见了一位小心翼翼抱着古老星图的青年。他在那张星图的尽头究竟在寻找着什么？而我的心，也随之泛起涟漪。在夏日的暑气中，属于两人的故事正悄然却又确凿地拉开序幕。
